family: NVIDIA Pascal GP100, Tesla P100 16 GB (sm_60)

LB_QW_GRAPH.source: lb-qwen35-c4-tuning-2026-11-16.md (76 tok/s decode with graphs) and c1-gemini-lessons-for-engine-2026-11-18.md section 1 (graphed verify 25.1 -> 21.5 ms). Same as the code default.

LB_MTP_DEPTH.source: c1-gemini-lessons-for-engine-2026-11-18.md section 1 (commit 4ab5e29): P100 AF+D8, Qwen3.6 Q5_K_M, depth 1 +16 % mean, depths 2-3 lose (verify of 2 rows 21.5 ms vs 15 ms a token). Only used when LB_MTP=1; whether MTP is on stays a per-seat decision.

LB_Q4_ROWS.source: docs/WORK_LOG.md (2026-11-07): 1.29x end to end in the device decode on a P100 (rows 4 vs 1). Same as the code default.

LB_PREFILL_UBATCH.source: docs/PREFILL_SPLIT.md: 2048 rows 780 tok/s vs 594 at 512, P100 in c2's Gen3 x4 slot, LFM2.5-24B Q4_0. Same as the code default.

LB_QW_ATTN_SPLIT.source: docs/P100_KERNEL_TUNING.md (2026-11-21, c4 P100 3B+86, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q5_K_M, split 21,19): decode at ~4.2k context 44.6 -> 61.7 (code) / 43.7 -> 61.8 (prose) tok/s, short context 69.9 -> 69.8; attention core at n=4096 818 -> 194 us a layer. Bit-identical (tests/p100_variants_bitwise.rs; 4/4 greedy shas equal).

LB_QW_Q6_LG.source: docs/P100_KERNEL_TUNING.md (2026-11-21, same setup): output head 1675 -> 1093 us, attn_q 64.9 -> 49.5 us; decode short 69.8 -> 71.4, ~4.2k context 61.7 -> 63.6 tok/s on top of LB_QW_ATTN_SPLIT. Bit-identical (tests/p100_variants_bitwise.rs; 4/4 greedy shas equal).

notes: pinned staging pool and cuMemHostRegister of the GGUF mmap are on by default for CUDA: miss path 0.28 ms vs 1.1 ms, 1.40x (memory gpu-zero-copy-miss-path, eec4500). Env-only switches LB_NO_PINNED / LB_NO_REGISTER.
LB_Q4_MATH stays f32: X7a f16 on sm_60 gave 1.03x and failed the accuracy gate (docs/WORK_TO_WEIGHTS.md X7a results).
LB_H2=1 (fp16 half2 prefill GEMM) is faster (930 vs 780 tok/s at 2k) but fails G1 (top-1 211/215): not adopted (docs/PREFILL_SPLIT.md).
QWEN_SPLIT (19,21 for the Tiel pair, 6,17,17 for the 2060+2xP100 seat) depends on model and card set: seat placement, kept in the manifest, not here.

LB_QW_PREFILL_CHUNK is not set (code default: auto, 64..1024 by prompt length). The 256 set on 2026-11-16 (Tiel Q5_K_XL on 2xP100 OOMed on a second long prompt with auto chunk) predates the Q8 dedup (b96fa22). Re-measured 2026-11-21 (docs/P100_KERNEL_TUNING.md, c4 P100 3B+86): Tiel split 19,21 ctx 8192, two 4.1-4.4k-token prompts x 3 rounds, auto chunk: no OOM (peak 15.7 / 15.5 GB), prefill 595-603 tok/s vs 402-418 at 256; Qwen3.6 21,19: 589/599 vs 417/434. Same greedy shas at every chunk. Set LB_QW_PREFILL_CHUNK=256 on a seat whose weights fill the cards more than these.
